subject: Rumi under-pool book: plot, world and game-integration revision
question: Owner direction for the commissioned under-pool book after the 2026-10-12 visual/detective edition.
decision: Owner: the book "needs significant plot revisions, and developments to be able to integrate smoothly into the game environment"; "Focus on producing rich, robust undersea world, the inspirations are clearly in the comics, but they appear narrow, and a bathhouse scene is not truly developed. Also, not nearly enough plotting to hold together such a long book." Analyse traditional comics for pacing and style and draft solutions as a Codex handoff. Commissions analysis and a written handoff; accepts no story, art or runtime change and commissions no playable chapter.
